name: Harness
description: Ask Claude to ship a build, trace a failed deployment, toggle a feature flag, or check cloud costs. It acts directly on Harness, no tab switching required. Numerous resource types across CI/CD, GitOps, security, and FinOps, all through conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Harness to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Harness to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.harness.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Harness MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Harness provides these MCP tools: harness_list, harness_get, harness_create, harness_update, harness_delete, harness_execute, harness_search, harness_diagnose, harness_describe, harness_status, and harness_schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Harness?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Harness in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Harness requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Harness is developed by Harness.io. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
